    raw msgbox "The boat goes back to the port you\ncame from whenever you like.\pShall we set sail?", MSGBOX_YESNO
    raw goto_if_eq VAR_RESULT, NO, BattleIsland_EventScript_SailorStay
    raw msgbox "All aboard!", MSGBOX_DEFAULT
    raw closemessage
    raw special MP_BattleIsland_Return
    raw waitstate
    raw end
    label BattleIsland_EventScript_SailorStay
    raw msgbox "Take your time. The STADIUM\nisn't going anywhere!", MSGBOX_DEFAULT
    raw release
    raw end
